reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: the while loop at line 50 terminates only when HashSet size equals custody_group_count, but all elements are bounded by mod NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS (128). When peer-reported custody_group_count > 128, the set saturates and the loop condition can never be satisfied, causing infinite loop. Spec reference from 01e_PARTIAL_MANUAL_15_109_190_216.json explicitly requires: 'Peer-reported custody_group_count must be validated against NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS upper bound before use in any loop or data structure sizing. handle_custody_groups must terminate in O(NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS) iterations regardless of the peer-advertised value.' No validation exists in the code. Single-packet P2P DoS is in-scope per bug bounty rules. Severity calibrated as Medium: affects individual nodes via P2P (not entire client population), single-packet attack vector, specific to PeerDAS functionality.
